HOW IT WORKS

Three steps.
‍Then we take it from here.

STEP 01

Audit

We review your current website: structure, speed, content setup, SEO basics, and maintenance risks. You get a clear picture of where things stand and what needs attention.

STEP 02

Build or Onboard

We either design and build your new site from scratch, or take over management of your existing one. Either way, you get a clean handover and a structured starting point.

STEP 03

Ongoing Management

You stay on a monthly plan. We handle updates, support requests, performance work, content publishing, and technical improvements — with clear reporting each month and a simple way to request changes.
